md.description: Display sizes should be used sparingly for short, impactful copy that aims to not exceed a single line in English. Brevity is key! Please be mindful of translations into Polish and German, where copy tends to become longer. We offer two Display sizes, Large and Medium. Display Large is to be used sparingly for short brand focused content whereas Display medium is our primary typography for marketing hero's.
